question: When and from where was GSAT-6A launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29 March 2018, Satish Dhawan Space Centre (Shriharikota)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **GSAT-6A satellite was launched from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) SHAR in Sriharikota, **India on March 29, 2018 at 11:26 UTC
